class.name: HSMCheckVar
class.brief_description: Transition condition that compares a blackboard variable with a value.
class.description: The native counterpart of [BTCheckVar] for [HSMTransition] rows: passes when [member variable] on the blackboard of the machine the condition is bound to compares to [member value] by [member check_type]. [member value] is a [BBVariant], so it can be a saved constant or another blackboard variable. A variable missing from the blackboard is reported as an error and the row does not pass.

members.member: The type of check to perform.
A parameter that specifies the value against which the [member variable] will be compared.
A variable whose value will be compared to [member value].
